fact: With PAIF-PME support, the 4,000-plus pensioners who were paid in cash are now paid through Mobile Money, and Treasury per diems are paid on prepaid cards, with civil servants' salaries still to be digitised.
title: Burkina Faso : quand le Trésor public rejoint l'ère du paiement numérique
publisher: World Bank, Africa Can End Poverty blog
